title: Kimiyyar yin burodi: auna, daidaitawa da sarrafa tanda

say: Kimiyyar yin burodi: auna, daidaitawa, da sarrafa tanda.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don modul ɗaya na Baking Baking and Pastry.
Kwararrun masu yin burodi ba sa bin girke-girke a makance. Suna aiki a cikin ma'auni da ma'auni, kuma suna yanke shawarar yawan alkama da suke so.

say: Gari da ƙwai suna gina tsari. ƙwai kaɗan kaɗan, kuma wainar ta nutse ko ta rushe. Da yawa, kuma ya zama roba.
Fat da sukari taushi. Canja gefe guda kuma dole ne kuyi tunani akan ɗayan.
Misali Halima a Kaduna ta rage kashi 20 cikin dari. Ta kara madara gram 25 don danshi, sannan ta duba cake din tun da farko, saboda karancin sukari yana nufin rage launin ruwan kasa.
Duk dagawa yana fitowa daga iska, tururi ko carbon dioxide. Baking powder tana ɗauke da acid ɗinta. Jagoran shine game da teaspoon 1 a kowace gram 125 na gari.

say: Kafin yin gasa, san ƙa'idodin aminci. Kunna murhun gas daidai yadda mai yin ya umarta, tare da buɗe kofa.

panel.heading: Gas tanda da kuma zafi aminci

cards.d: Kunna murhun gas daidai yadda mai yin ya umarta, tare da buɗe kofa.
Kashe gas a silinda. Hasken komai, babu masu juyawa. Bude tagogi kuma a duba shi.
Ajiye bargon wuta ko abin kashe wuta mai dacewa. Yi amfani da safofin hannu masu kauri, busassun tanda, kar a taɓa ɗanɗano yadi.

say: Idan kuna jin warin gas, kashe shi a silinda. Kada ku kunna komai ko kunna fitilu. Bude tagogi da ƙofofi, kuma a duba ɗigon ruwa kafin amfani da tanda kuma.

say: Don tunawa. Yi auna gram kuma yi amfani da adadin mai yin burodi. Sarrafa alkama da ruwa, hadawa, mai da sukari. Daidaita magina da masu tausasawa.
Duba masu yisti a kan jagorar. Kuma amince da ma'aunin zafin jiki na tanda, ba bugun kira ba.

Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
